Kangana Ranaut Criticizes Kriti Sanon's Rakhi Ad; Fashion Choices Debated

Actress Kangana Ranaut has reportedly criticized Kriti Sanon's Rakhi advertisement, sparking a debate about fashion choices. Following Ranaut's comments, social media users began questioning Ranaut's own fashion decisions, particularly her attire at the National Awards. This exchange has brought attention to past instances where Ranaut herself commented on women's clothing choices, with some recalling her statements that a woman's attire is her own business.
